references.text: Joshua hands the kings over to Israel, and the Lord gives their kings into Israel's hand, just as promised in Deuteronomy 7:24
The list of defeated kings shows the fulfillment of the promise that God would give the kings into Israel's hand
God promises Joshua that no one will be able to stand against him, the same promise given in Deuteronomy 7:24
Joshua reminds the people that no one has been able to stand against them, as a fulfillment of the promise
God promises to blot out the memory of Amalek under heaven, the same expression used for bloting out names
Moses repeats that the Lord will go before the people and destroy the nations, so that no one can stand against Israel
Repeats the promise that no one will be able to stand against Israel when God puts fear into their enemies
Command to blot out the memory of Amalek under heaven, parallel to the bloting out of names
God hands the Canaanites over to Israel as they destroy them and their cities completely
